relevant_laws.notes: Vehicle-specific unladen weight, local civil time, residence frontage/business exclusion, truck-route extents and written DPW permit scope/conditions require independent original-source review. No worker legal verdict.
relevant_laws.quote: No vehicle in excess of eight thousand pounds unladen weight shall be operated or moved upon any street (other than a truck route), in any residence district between the hours of seven p.m. and six a.m.; provided, however, that the Department of Public Works may, at its discretion, upon application in writing, issue a special permit in writing authorizing the applicant to operate or move such vehicle between the hours of seven p.m. and six a.m. In issuing such permit, the Department may impose such conditions thereon, such as routes to be followed, time of operation or movement, or other matters, as it deems necessary or desirable.
